definition: This dimension controls the allocation and consumption of action points in turn-based combat, which varies from games having fixed action points per turn to more flexible systems allowing players to spend varying amounts of points for different actions. This affects the pace and strategy of combat, influencing how players approach each encounter and manage their resources.
inclusion_criteria: Games with fixed action points per turn
Games with variable action point costs for different actions
title: Action Points Variation in Turn-Based Combat
